name: Keto Braised Beef Short Ribs
ingredients_verbatim: 1/2 cup red wine or additional beef broth
why: Verified published macros (411.57 cal, 1.48g carbs, 40.46g protein per serving) land squarely in the low-carb band with standout protein. Whole-muscle beef, braised low-and-slow (oven or slow cooker) with only aromatics + broth + wine -- structurally very low carb, no starch base, batch-scales to 14 by multiplying the braise. Distinct from catalog (no short-rib braise exists). Signature short ribs have no board home (board tracks beef-chuck-roast) -- flagged for the pricer lane per this round's mandate; red wine and avocado oil likely also unmapped. Calories sit near the floor at 412 so watch the recompute, but the dish is fatty (25g fat) and label-accurate short-rib rows should hold it in band.
